title: GovernanceRefusal
description: The closed vocabulary of AI governance refusal reason codes (ADR-0006 §2.5, ADR-0016 §2.4). These strings appear in logs, metrics, evidence and responses on both sides of the boundary and mean the same thing in all of them.
$comment: Go: ai.RefusalCodes (tested equal). Python: ztax_gateway.governance.Refusal (tested equal too). Both sides raise AI_DATA_CLASS_REFUSED for an ordinary policy refusal (a class outside the allowlist, or P7). When the two policy functions are called directly, bypassing wire decode, the reason code for a malformed label (empty, unknown, wrong case) can differ between them -- see contracts/privacy/data-class-parity-cases.json.
